## About
Extreme Roofing of San Diego, Inc. is a family owned and operated roofing company based on El Nopal in Lakeside. We handle roofing repairs, new roofs and complete re-roofs, on both the residential and commercial sides, and we also offer emergency services.
We're a referral based company. Every one of our crews has a highly trained job foreman on site, and we'd be glad to quote your project, large or small.
Our customers give us 4.5 stars from 32 Google reviews. They mention people like DJ, who came out to look a roof over before the bid, DJ and Josh, who kept one homeowner's contract on track, and Gil and Chris, who ran the crews on site.

## Services
- Roofing repairs: Repairs for homes and commercial buildings. We have a very high success rate in roof repairs.
- New roofs: New roofs for residential and commercial properties, with a job foreman on every crew.
- Complete re-roofs: Tear-off and full replacement. One reviewer had old shingles and fascia boards removed and replaced, with the yard cleaned up each day.
- Emergency services: Call us when a roof can't wait.
- Commercial roofing: We work for some of the largest property management companies in San Diego, as well as general contractors in the county.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us for a free estimate and consultation on your project, large or small.

Q: What areas do you work in?
A: We work throughout San Diego County, and we've also traveled to Imperial County and Los Angeles County.

Q: What is your contractor license number?
A: Our contractor license number is 769388.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I message you?
A: If needed, you'll hear back within 48-72 hours.
